title: Warm Pungent Spanish Hazelnut Tarta De Santiago
description: A vegan friendly Spanish Basque dish featuring hazelnuts, this tarta de Santiago is a pungent and molten treat perfect for kids and adults alike. It is made with a deglaze fond and hazelnuts for a rich and nutty flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and salt.
Add the non dairy milk, canola oil, apple cider vinegar, and vanilla extract to the bowl and stir until a dough forms.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch.
Transfer the dough to a 9 inch round cake pan.
Bake the tarta for 35 minutes or until the edges are golden brown.
Remove the tarta from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Drizzle the tarta with a deglaze fond made from reduced non dairy milk and serve warm.
